title: Bench → Blue/Dodeca/Pink: gemeinsames Integrationspaket 1–5
scope: One local engineering work package inside the existing A0 Book. Not a new Lab, study, canonical module or registry.
ownerAuthorization: Owner requested points 1–5 as one package to consolidate implementation.
goal: Existing Bench command → addressed actual Dodeca face → confirmed pose → source-derived shadow/echo → exact scoped source Return → unified record → actual browser acceptance.

existing.slots: 4×12 body face slots +12 Return face slots; reuse all existing IDs
existing.sourceSet: Existing actual native renderer and geometry are authority. A separately redrawn dodecahedron does not count as runtime binding.

milestones.goal: One owner-selected actual face through the complete chain 1–5
milestones.defaultPolicy: Selected face and hinge edge must be declared in the run record; geometric edge order is not historical meaning.

milestones.goal: Four selected faces, one per Blue/Pink satellite, only after M1 acceptance
Broader multi-face use without replacing existing 60-slot ledger

tasks.title: Echte Flächensteuerung
deliverables: Native renderer control adapter, actual face ID and selected edge (two original vertex IDs)
Single selected face hinge motion with fixed edge, rigid facet metrics and explicit non-closed-solid boundary during opening
Readback from actual renderer state rather than a parent-side recomputation
acceptance: Existing face/cell IDs preserved; no new geometry authority
Five selected vertices and hinge endpoint positions verified through motion
Other faces unchanged unless an explicit operator says otherwise
No second free-running source clock
tasks.gap: Closed for deterministic engineering: native renderer exposes selection, explicit hinge edge, rigid-facet readback and parent transport. Rendered browser acceptance remains under point 5.

tasks.title: Gemeinsame Sequenz
deliverables: One bounded coordinator, typed commands, one pending mutation, source revision/nonce/sequence and ACK readback
Explicit sequence table relating 29 display poses, 16 book stations and actual source commands, without equating their carriers
Pause/HOLD/Return, lost-ACK recovery via read only; no mutation retry
acceptance: Next step waits for the prior confirmed source state
No simultaneous unsynchronized players
All steps record requested parameters and actual readback
Sequence schedule, endpoints and any repeat/return policy are explicit
tasks.gap: Book and 5B have separate players with mutual pause; Q4-follow is only a display resampling.

tasks.title: Achsen und Übergangslesart
deliverables: Book material polylines 2–O–5, 3–O–6 and 1–O–4 as explicit source-labelled measurement references
Separate fixed outer reference and moving hinge
AM/VM/PM transition labels only with an explicit view-role mapping; V/R material-face labels remain distinct
M/Umlauf marker separated from LRRL branch trace
acceptance: No identification of book polygon with a regular dodeca face without a declared mapping
No mix of independent point-number registers
No new canonical Family/vocabulary adoption
LRRL excursion and true winding are not equated
openChoices: Meaning of M as a view label, not recovered historical operator
Mapping of book axes onto a selected native face

tasks.title: Gemeinsamer Record und Source-Return
deliverables: One export holding source address/hinge, commands, ACKs/revisions, book, 5B, overlay settings and separate histories
Source-owned capture/Return covering all declared native cell-view state including motion phase, not just selected UI fields
Importer/replay with source/hash validation and bounded history semantics
acceptance: A snapshot export is not labelled a completed or accepted run
Return compares restored source state with the captured source anchor
View-only Return does not substitute for source Return
History truncation, source scopes and missing components remain explicit
tasks.nowImplemented: Native source runtime captures the full declared renderer view state, confirms commands, returns readback and restores an exact fingerprinted source anchor. A versioned fail-closed envelope exports Native Face, A·i·l and Ninefold records, validates source/schema identity, replays serial source commands and finishes with RESTORE_RECORD plus exact fingerprint receipt. Binder System D retains the confirmed source record.
tasks.gap: Rendered browser acceptance remains open; importer/replay engineering coverage is complete.

tasks.title: Abnahme und Currentness
deliverables: Engineering tests for geometry, transport, sequence, export/replay and Return failure modes (PASS)
Actual owner/browser run with visible addressed face movement and returned source state
Separate bounded currentness reconciliation against approved baselines
acceptance: End-to-end browser receipt from the actual native source, not mock DOM alone
Timeout, wrong window/nonce/revision, malformed geometry, pause and lost ACK handled fail-closed
No silent canonical pin updates to turn known failures green
Package accepted only when all required checks pass; report remaining open items
knownLimits: Prior file-browser automation denial remains respected
Existing A0 evidence binder retains eight known hash mismatches
Existing engineering test passes do not establish full end-to-end browser acceptance

exportPolicy.scope: Read-only composite snapshot of currently connected local views, not a synchronized run receipt.
exportPolicy.missingSource: Dodeca remains HOLD until its iframe runtime acknowledges HELLO and CAPTURE; no parent-side substitute is accepted.
exportPolicy.history: Overlay retains latest 64 visited poses per source since page load; not a whole-research archive.

layeredSceneProgress.implemented: One phase drives three planar pentagon layers, central reused H3 geometry, exact 2D overlap/differences, two mask windows and a reference curve. Third separate overlay history and shared export are wired.
layeredSceneProgress.stillOpen: Native 60-cell control/hinge/readback, global 16/29/native-source coordination, exact native Source-Return and browser acceptance.

stopConditions: Need for undeclared canonical Family/vocabulary changes
Need for research execution or new scientific claims
